the DBP formation rate is strongly dependent on the flow velocity, pipe materials and the mass-transfer enhanced reaction kinetics.

the rate of THMs formation can be reduced by increasing the flow velocity in the distribution systems.
the rate of DBP production is highly sensitive to the hydrodynamics and pipe materials in the distribution system.
